name: default
description: Three phases, after AI-DLC's inception -> construction -> operations. What differs is that the gate here is code, the approval binds to a tree digest, and the run ends in a signed statement.

phases.name: inception
phases.description: Prove the inputs are sound before building anything on them. Regenerating the site's derived data is the cheapest possible proof that all 5k corpus files still parse.

phases.name: construction
phases.description: Build and test, then gate. The gate runs after the steps so it judges the change as it now stands, not as it was declared.

phases.name: operations
phases.description: Requires a recorded human approval bound to this exact tree, this plan and this policy pack. The step re-proves the artifact pillar's central claim under a hostile environment.
